Integrator should confirm.

notes: Kellogg (Northwestern) 'Job Placements of Kellogg Ph.D. Students' lists all departments by placement year; yearMeaning recorded as 'placement' from the page heading, although the page also uses the phrase 'No students on the job market' for empty years and the Financial Economics section says '2023 represents our first class of graduates'. Each snapshot drops the oldest year and adds a new one (2024-12-10 covers 2014-2024, 2025-09-08 covers 2015-2025, 2026-08-13 covers 2016-2026), so older snapshots are the only source for 2014/2015. Destination strings are copied whole except where the first comma-separated segment is a title (Postdoctoral Fellow/Scholar, Post-doctoral Research Fellow, Visiting Professor, Principle Researcher [sic], Senior Research Fellow, IPE Fellow, Bigelow Teaching Fellow), which was moved to position. Kellogg oddities kept as written: 'loannis (Yannis) Stamatopoulos' (page misspells Ioannis with a lowercase L), 'Paolina C. Medina' appears under both Finance 2017 and Managerial Economics & Strategy 2017, 'Zhuqing (Clair) Yang' (2016, postdoc) and 'Clair Zhuqing Yang' (2017) are listed in consecutive years of Managerial Economics & Strategy, 'Principle Researcher' is the page's spelling. A live.txt also exists in the Kellogg snapshot folder but was not listed in the chunk and was not read. Yale operations page (2020-09-24) lists one 'Recent Graduate' (Cheng Hua) with no year and six current students (skipped). MSU logistics page lists five placed graduates by initials with graduation years in prose; their positions are described as current at capture (e.g. Goldsby 'currently a professor'), so destination/position should not be treated as a verified first job; six current students with 'Expected Graduation Year' were skipped. UNC Kenan-Flagler page (2020-09-22) lists 13 job market candidates across all areas with no year (listedYear null); its 'Recent Placements' is an institution list without names and was not recorded; its 'Related News' teasers mention Chaitali 'Tali' Kapadia (PhD '17) and Claudia Kubowicz Malhotra (MBA '00, PhD '06), not recorded because they are news items rather than list entries. OSU Fisher Operations Management PhD alumni table (two identical snapshots, 2017-12-11 and 2018-11-18) gives Graduation Year, Initial Placement, First Tenure-Granting Institution (blank for all) and Current Institution; Initial Placement is recorded as destination and Current Institution in note; spellings such as 'Univeristy', 'Illinios', 'Bera College', 'Chrisopher Moyer' are the page's. Berkeley Haas job market candidates page (2020-09-25) names only one candidate (Marketing); Accounting, Business and Public Policy, Finance and Real Estate sections were empty or 'coming soon'.
